$ cat create_holes.c
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <string.h>

#define HSIZE  512L

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
    int fd, i, n, nholes, nw;
    char *buf="Random data for creating holes.";

    /* Open the given file */
    if (argc != 3) {
        printf("Inappropriate number of command line arguments.\n");
        exit(0);
    }
    nholes = atoi(argv[2]);
    if ((fd = open(argv[1], O_WRONLY)) == -1) {
        perror("File opening");
        exit(1);
    }
    for (i=0; i<nholes; i++) {
        n = lseek(fd, HSIZE, SEEK_END);
        nw = write(fd, buf, strlen(buf));
    }
    if (close(fd) == -1) {
        perror("File closing");
        exit(1);
    }
    return(0);
}
